subject: Intermittent emit pauses during live demo — urgent escalation
messages:
From: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@novaplex.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Realtime demo - intermittent pauses and 504 during walkthrough

Rachel,

We just finished the customer-facing demo for Novaplex Search (hosted in us-west) and saw repeated stalls in the streaming results. The UI shows an initial burst of tokens, then a pause of ~6-12s with a 504 in the console for some requests. This happened across two model variants (rwd-7b-opt and rwd-13b-q4). Our SRE captured a WebSocket timeline and I attached a short trace and screenshot.

This is high-impact — Mina (CEO) was on the call and asked how stable this will be in production. Renewal conversation starts next month. Can you escalate? We need immediate mitigation or a fallback we can enable.

Attachments: novaplex_debug_trace.txt, screenshot_ws_trace.png

Thanks,
Rajesh
Platform Ops, Novaplex

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@novaplex.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Realtime demo - intermittent pauses and 504 during walkthrough

Rajesh —

Thanks for the quick report and for sharing the trace. I'm really sorry you had to see that live (and that Mina was on the call). We've elevated this as a priority and looping in engineering (David, Karthik) to triage immediately.

Immediate next steps:
- Can you confirm whether the demo traffic was routed through our dedicated pool or hosted API? (trace looks like hosted)
- For the short term we can enable a per-route fallback to rwd-3b for the demo traffic while we investigate; that usually removes the long tail. Do you want me to flip that now?
- We'll request the full socket-level pcap from your SRE if available — the trace you attached is helpful but we may need the handshake and keepalive details.

I'll send an internal escalation note to leadership and propose credit for the demo interruptions if we can't remediate within 24 hours.

—Rachel
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Realtime demo - intermittent pauses and 504 during walkthrough

Thanks Rachel / Rajesh.

Quick triage notes after a first pass on the trace:
- We see repeated chunked-transfer stalls correlated with KV-cache miss spikes and a surge of small concurrent connections (approx 120 simultaneous demo clients at the ramp peak).
- Several requests show socket-level FIN/ACK tears shortly before the 504s — suggests intermediate proxy timeouts or an edge NGinx instance closing idle streams.
- Both model variants show identical behavior; not isolated to quantization path.

Immediate mitigations I can apply now (requires a short restart of the demo route):
1) Increase websocket keepalive and proxy_read_timeout on the edge for the Novaplex route.
2) Enable fallback route to rwd-3b with aggressive prefix caching for new connections.

I'll attach a minimal diagnostic bundle (novaplex_edge_summary.log) to the ticket. If Rajesh can share the full pcap that'd help confirm whether it's our edge or a customer NAT middlebox.

-D

From: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@novaplex.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 17:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Realtime demo - intermittent pauses and 504 during walkthrough

Thanks David — we were on hosted and not using a custom VPC. I've asked our SRE to send the full pcap to the Drive folder I shared (link below).

We need the fallback to rwd-3b now for client-facing demos; please go ahead. Also want to capture a concrete timeline for mitigation (ETA) and whether this is likely to recur during steady traffic. Mina is asking for a brief note she can share with the board if this persists.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/novaplex/traces/NPX-20270621

- Rajesh

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 18:07:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Novaplex live demo stalls — request for exec attention and remediation plan

Team —

Novaplex experienced repeated streaming stalls and 504s during a live demo (Mina Iyer, CEO, was present). Account is at renewal evaluation in mid-July (deal NPX-2024-087). They were on hosted API in us-west; incident appears tied to chunked transfer stalls at the edge during a client ramp.

Asks:
- Engineering: urgent triage (David, Karthik). Proposed immediate actions: apply edge timeout increases and enable rwd-3b fallback for demo traffic. Can you confirm ETA for these changes and the plan to root-cause?
- Solutions/CS (Stephanie): prepare a short customer-facing incident note and proposed goodwill credit (I recommend 25% of demo-month invoices or a one-time credit equivalent).
- Leadership: request visibility if remediation isn't completed within 8 hours so I can escalate to Novaplex execs and legal if they ask.

Impacts: potential renewal risk, CEO visibility, and marketing demo collateral already scheduled. We should assume high sensitivity and keep communications conservative until we have a firm root cause.

I'll coordinate the customer comms and postmortem once resolved.

—Rachel

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Novaplex live demo stalls — request for exec attention and remediation plan

Acknowledged. We can implement the edge timeout and fallback changes within the hour; I'll own the rollout and post-deploy validation. Immediate plan:
- 09:30: increase websocket keepalive and proxy_read_timeout for novaplex route (edge config change, rolling units)
- 09:45: enable route fallback to rwd-3b with prefix cache for new connections (no model switch for existing inflight sessions)
- 10:15: run ramp test with Novaplex SRE (I will join) and validate chunk continuity for 30m.

If the ramp repros the failure we'll snapshot logs and follow with a hotfix to our chunked-transfer kernel. I'll update infra incident ticket INF-1428 with timestamps, and recommend the proposed 25% demo credit be approved by Ops & Sales.

-Olga
Senior Director, Inference Ops
